counterfactual_missing_items: No AFB smear/culture/PCR or interferon-gamma release assay is reported.
No CSF analysis (cell count, protein, glucose, AFB) is reported.
No HIV/immunocompromise status is reported to exclude fungal dissemination.
decisive_items: persistent fever, night sweats, a 15-kg weight loss
numerous bilateral tiny nodules throughout both lung fields
response.rationale: R7 is the only candidate that integrates the constitutional symptoms, miliary pulmonary distribution, cavitary lesions, and, by dissemination, the CNS meningoencephalitis. R1 captures only the brain MRI finding, while R3/R6 share only nonspecific systemic/pulmonary spans and miss both cavitary and CNS features. R2 is contradicted by cavitary lesions, and R4 is a descriptive imaging syndrome rather than an underlying etiology.

rejected.why: Sarcoidosis is contradicted by cavitary lesions and does not explain the infectious constitutional syndrome or CNS hemorrhage.
Shares nonspecific systemic/pulmonary spans but lacks the cavitary and CNS findings; less complete than tuberculosis.
Hemorrhagic meningoencephalitis is the imaging syndrome, not the underlying diagnosis.
Same nonspecific systemic/pulmonary spans as R3; histoplasmosis lacks cavitary and CNS features and has no supportive exposure clue.
